label: Training label: 1 iff case A (direct_em=0 AND rag_em=1, i.e. RAG fixed a direct error). 0 iff case B (direct_em=1 AND rag_em=0, i.e. RAG broke a correct direct). TIE rows (both correct OR both wrong) are DROPPED from training entirely - their labels are CHM-tiebreak noise that drags AUROC. At inference, ties default to T2 (cheaper) by virtue of the high tau threshold.
overfit_diagnostic: C=1.0 sweep showed train_AUROC=0.698 vs cv_AUROC=0.626 (gap 0.072 = mild overfit). Reduced C to 0.005 to regularise — cv_AUROC lifted to 0.6471 (+0.021).
regularisation_note: C=0.005 (stronger regularisation than sklearn default 1.0). Diagnosed mild overfit at C=1.0 (train/cv AUROC gap 0.072); lowering C to 0.005 lifts CV AUROC by +0.021 and reduces gap to ~0.05. Compressed probabilities mean tau=0.60 over-conservative; retuned default to tau=0.400.

v2_retune_contract.note: v1 hyperparameters (C=0.005, tau=0.40) are SCALE-SPECIFIC and must be re-tuned at v2. The n/p ratio jumps from 22 (v1) to ~125 (v2), so overfit pressure drops sharply and the optimal C should land closer to sklearn's default. tau follows the probability distribution, which depends on C.
v2_procedure: Inner 5-fold CV inside each outer-fold train set for C selection; sweep {0.005, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.5, 1.0, 5.0}.
Re-fit on all v2 clean rows with the most-frequent winning C.
Sweep tau in {0.10, 0.15, ..., 0.80} on full-data predictions, pick the tau that maximises (A_caught - B_caught) on the v2 distribution.
